title: Electrician

startNotice.title: For learning only
startNotice.text: This role is **arithmetic practice only**. Every figure and table is made up, and none of it is a wiring rule or a design value. **Never work on real wiring** from these questions: that needs a qualified electrician and your local rules.

description: Circuit loads, breakers, cable and voltage drop, resistor networks and running costs: arithmetic practice with made-up tables and every rule stated.

subroles.title: Installation Electrician
subroles.description: Circuit loads, breaker choice from a stated list, cable sizing from a stated table and voltage drop.

subroles.title: Maintenance Electrician
subroles.description: Fault finding with Ohm's law, series and parallel resistance, power and the running cost of motors and appliances.

subroles.title: Solar PV Installer
subroles.description: Panel power and roof areas, cable and voltage drop, and the running cost and payback of an installation.

subroles.title: Controls Electrician
subroles.description: Resistor codes, voltage dividers, LED resistors, RC timing and logic gates in control circuits, plus fault finding.
